name: robohorse
description: A side-scrolling action game where you control RoboHorse, a six-legged cyber-horse, against the invading Cephalopod Armada!

scripts.deploy: pnpm build && mkdir -p deploy/robohorse && cp frontend/*.html deploy/robohorse/ && mkdir -p deploy/robohorse/dist && cp frontend/dist/*.bundle.js deploy/robohorse/dist/ && cp -r frontend/css deploy/robohorse/ && cp -r frontend/images deploy/robohorse/ && cp -r frontend/audio deploy/robohorse/ && cp README.md deploy/robohorse/ && ([ -f frontend/favicon.png ] && cp frontend/favicon.png deploy/robohorse/ || cp frontend/images/elon.png deploy/robohorse/favicon.png || echo 'No favicon found')
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm deploy && rsync -avz --delete deploy/robohorse/ apprunner@games.smoxu.com:/var/www/games.smoxu.com/robohorse/ && pnpm post-deploy
scripts.post-deploy:
echo '
⚠️  REMINDER: Make sure to check/update the .env file on the server if needed.
   ssh apprunner@games.smoxu.com
   cd /var/www/games.smoxu.com/robohorse
   nano .env
'
